entries.what: Graph API v20.0 expired. The versioning guide says calls to an expired version are defaulted to the next oldest usable version, so this usually does not raise an error: the code runs at v21.0 today, with fields and behavior it was not written for, and v21.0 itself ends January 21, 2027. Marketing API calls at this version ended earlier, on 2025-05-06. Marketing API endpoints do not get that promise: a call may fail or be upgraded. None of this was tested live.

entries.versions: Compare the exact string v20.0: v2.1 is not v2.10, and a newer pin is fine. Forms: /vMAJOR.MINOR/ in a Graph URL (graph.facebook.com, graph-video.facebook.com, graph.instagram.com, rupload.facebook.com/<upload-type>/, www.facebook.com/.../dialog/oauth), a config or env value such as GRAPH_API_VERSION, FB.init({version}), and mobile setVersion. Business SDKs pin it: for facebook-nodejs-business-sdk, the facebook-business Python package and facebook/php-business-sdk, the package major.minor is the API version (26.0.3 sends v26.0; checked in each SDK source: FacebookAdsApi.VERSION in src/api.js, API_VERSION in facebook_business/apiconfig.py, APIVersion in ApiConfig.php). A range like >=18 floats, so read the lockfile. An unversioned Graph call uses the version set in the app dashboard, so the repo alone cannot say. An unversioned Marketing API call is a certain failure, not an unknown: "Unversioned calls are invalid and will fail when made against Marketing API endpoints." Messenger follows Graph API versioning. The Marketing API runs on its own shorter schedule: a version live for Graph may be dead for ad calls (see MG-2).

entries.replacement: v27.0, released November 4, 2026 per Meta's announcement, which is the latest the Graph API changelog names. The versions table still tops out at v26.0 and has no v27.0 changelog page yet, so v27.0's changes come from the announcement. requires: Change the version everywhere it lives, not one place: URL paths, config and env values, FB.init version, the sdk.js#version= fragment on connect.facebook.net, the facebook.com/vN/dialog/oauth login URL, mobile setVersion calls, and the Business SDK dependency.

v27.0, from the announcement (https://developers.facebook.com/blog/post/2026/11/04/introducing-graph-api-v27-and-marketing-api-v27/): Marketing API /{catalog-id}/batch no longer works, use /{catalog-id}/items_batch. lookalike_spec rejects country and location_spec: remove both. New Sales ad sets targeting specific devices or operating systems reach other devices unless targeting.targeting_automation.individual_setting.device is 0. Meta may turn on Product showcase unless product_extensions.enroll_status is OPT_OUT. From November 4, 2026, on all Graph versions, new apps can't use multi-ID requests, date/time formatting, HTTP method override, field aliases, JSONP callbacks or asynchronous batch requests, and existing apps can't start new uses. Multi-ID and date/time formatting went in v26.0, and the rest stop for all requests at v28.0.

v26.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version26.0): on New Pages Experience pages current_location, genre, network, parking and start_info return a version error, and auto_publish_page_info_updates is gone from Page settings. Rights Manager reference_owner, matched_reference_owner, sending_rights_holder and receiving_rights_holder become reference_owner_rh_owner, matched_reference_owner_rh_owner, sending_rights_holder_owner and receiving_rights_holder_owner. HEC-F ad sets with relaxable targeting must set targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1 or 0. Requests naming the Instagram Explore Feed placement return an error. Eligible creatives default to destination_type WEBSITE_AND_SHOP unless set to WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT.

v24.0 and v25.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version24.0, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version25.0): overlay_url is gone from live videos. is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled is required when budgets sit at ad set level. The Facebook video feeds placement returns an error. Creating Messenger lead ads through the API is deprecated. Failed async ad reports return new error fields and error_code becomes int.

v22.0 and v23.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version22.0, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version23.0): GET /<PAGE_ID>/ratings returns error 12. STANDARD_ENHANCEMENTS and Segment Asset Customization are no longer supported. The promotions field becomes promotion_details. destination_ids no longer takes instagram_actor_id: use ig_user_id. New ad sets on the default or relaxed setup opt in to Advantage+ audience.
v21.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version21.0): new ad sets or ads with non-ODAX objectives can no longer be created.

requires: Change the version everywhere it lives, not one place: URL paths, config and env values, FB.init version, the sdk.js#version= fragment on connect.facebook.net, the facebook.com/vN/dialog/oauth login URL, mobile setVersion calls, and the Business SDK dependency.

v27.0, from the announcement (https://developers.facebook.com/blog/post/2026/11/04/introducing-graph-api-v27-and-marketing-api-v27/): Marketing API /{catalog-id}/batch no longer works, use /{catalog-id}/items_batch. lookalike_spec rejects country and location_spec: remove both. New Sales ad sets targeting specific devices or operating systems reach other devices unless targeting.targeting_automation.individual_setting.device is 0. Meta may turn on Product showcase unless product_extensions.enroll_status is OPT_OUT. From November 4, 2026, on all Graph versions, new apps can't use multi-ID requests, date/time formatting, HTTP method override, field aliases, JSONP callbacks or asynchronous batch requests, and existing apps can't start new uses. Multi-ID and date/time formatting went in v26.0, and the rest stop for all requests at v28.0.

v26.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version26.0): on New Pages Experience pages current_location, genre, network, parking and start_info return a version error, and auto_publish_page_info_updates is gone from Page settings. Rights Manager reference_owner, matched_reference_owner, sending_rights_holder and receiving_rights_holder become reference_owner_rh_owner, matched_reference_owner_rh_owner, sending_rights_holder_owner and receiving_rights_holder_owner. HEC-F ad sets with relaxable targeting must set targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1 or 0. Requests naming the Instagram Explore Feed placement return an error. Eligible creatives default to destination_type WEBSITE_AND_SHOP unless set to WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT.

v24.0 and v25.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version24.0, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version25.0): overlay_url is gone from live videos. is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled is required when budgets sit at ad set level. The Facebook video feeds placement returns an error. Creating Messenger lead ads through the API is deprecated. Failed async ad reports return new error fields and error_code becomes int.

v22.0 and v23.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version22.0, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version23.0): GET /<PAGE_ID>/ratings returns error 12. STANDARD_ENHANCEMENTS and Segment Asset Customization are no longer supported. The promotions field becomes promotion_details. destination_ids no longer takes instagram_actor_id: use ig_user_id. New ad sets on the default or relaxed setup opt in to Advantage+ audience.
v21.0 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version21.0): new ad sets or ads with non-ODAX objectives can no longer be created.

Older moves: read each changelog from the version after this one up to v20.0, at https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/version<N>.0. They hold removed fields, permissions and endpoints this list only samples. WhatsApp and Messenger changes are in their own changelogs.
